component.name: OpenIDEA
component.summary: Native IDE with code insight, debugging, Git and a terminal

description.p: This community-maintained Flatpak package runs the official OpenIDEA Linux release unmodified, with separate Git and uv support tools for development inside the sandbox.
OpenIDEA is a Rust-based IDE with an IntelliJ IDEA-style keymap, code insight, a debugger, Git integration, a terminal, and database and HTTP clients.

Projects in your Documents folder are accessible by default. Toolchains and terminals run inside the Flatpak sandbox: host-installed SDKs and host container engines are not available. Select sandbox SDKs in OpenIDEA's settings; supported SDK downloads are available through the IDE. Git and uv are supplied as separate pinned support downloads.
Native debugging is enabled through Flatpak development syscall access (including ptrace). Debug targets and toolchains run inside the sandbox.

For Python debugging, select an interpreter with pip installed. You can create one in the integrated terminal with uv venv --seed .venv, select .venv/bin/python in the Python interpreter settings, then use Install and Debug.
Optional permissions can be enabled for your workflow:

ul.li: Read host SSH keys: flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/.ssh:ro ai.l0ng.openidea
